faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Sephiria.

items.question: What is Sephiria?
items.answer: Sephiria is a top-down action roguelite by TEAM HORAY, the studio behind Dungreed. You play a brave bunny descending a tower to save the town of Bunnyville. It left Steam Early Access with the full 1.0 release on July 31, 2026.

items.question: What is the best weapon in Sephiria?
items.answer: For the 1.0 meta, Greatsword and Staff are widely considered the top picks: Greatsword for heavy damage and wide coverage, Staff for flexible ranged control. Katana and Crossbow are strong alternatives once you are comfortable with the game.

items.question: Does Sephiria have co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Sephiria supports online co-op for up to 4 players through Steam, with item trading and teammate revives. If invites or connections fail, our co-op troubleshooting guide covers the most common fixes.

items.question: How do I find secret rooms in Sephiria?
items.answer: Secret rooms hide behind cracked or discolored walls. Watch for subtle tile differences on each floor, then attack the wall to break it open. Constellation rooms work the same way and count toward 100% completion.

items.question: Is Sephiria worth buying?
items.answer: Sephiria costs $14.99 on Steam and holds a Very Positive rating from over 5,500 reviews. Reviewers frequently compare it to Enter the Gungeon and The Binding of Isaac, and it runs great on Steam Deck.

aboutGame.title: What is Sephiria?
paragraphs: Sephiria is a top-down action roguelite developed by TEAM HORAY, the Korean indie studio behind Dungreed. Players guide a brave bunny down a doomed tower, mastering six weapon classes, collecting talismans and artifacts, and arranging a puzzle-like inventory to save the town of Bunnyville.
The game entered Steam Early Access on April 3, 2025 and fully launched as version 1.0 on July 31, 2026, earning a Very Positive rating across more than 5,500 reviews.
